protocol: Five equal-weight splits; verifier rows average metrics over 3 seeds (not prediction ensemble). Localization uses unchanged target own published proposals, positive queries, IoU 0.50:0.05:0.95, max 10 proposals. Seen-val: target Seen validation Youden J on 100 grid points [0.01,0.99], accept score>=tau. Fixed-0.4: original paper decision accept score>0.4. Metrics in percent; localization and G-mIoU computed with repository official functions, rounded per split to 2 decimals then averaged.
